nodes.label: Perfume Aura Ops product
nodes.summary: Owned system of record for inventory, sales documents, payments, and operational finance.

nodes.label: ops primary user: owner
nodes.summary: Primary user maintains products/variants, stock history, invoices, payments, and financial signals; staff is later concern; current product owner-only.

nodes.label: ops brand personality trustworthy precise restrained
nodes.summary: Interface aligns with dark luxury direction while remaining an efficient business tool.

nodes.label: ops design principles
nodes.summary: Visible operational truth, familiar controls, safeguards at decision points, restrained identity, first-class empty/loading/validation/archived states.

nodes.label: ops anti-references
nodes.summary: Reject public storefront in admin, novelty SaaS dashboards, bespoke controls when shadcn exists, and discarding locked base-luma/taupe tokens.

nodes.label: ops accessibility and inclusion
nodes.summary: Mobile-usable, keyboard-operable, visible focus, contrast, non-color status, reduced-motion respect.
